messages:
Glen: Kicking off OrbitEdge EAP. Partner wants a 4-day bench window, tight telemetry limits (no raw prompts), and a co-list if numbers look good. Who owns NDA + bench?

Yara: I can run benches. Lab window tentatively 12/5-12/8 UTC. We'll provision 2x OE-120 blades (partner image). Plan: micro-latency, mem-heavy, and 24h soak.

Moss: I'll handle marketplace/comms. Need SVG/PNG logo and a 2-sentence partner quote. Also propose a short joint post if perf is strong.

Kira: Legal: partner requires hashed request IDs (SHA-256) + aggregated metrics only. Retention asked = 60 days. I'll draft an NDA addendum with KMS requirement. ETA ~3h.

Yara: Bench flags suggestion: `./run_bench --model=redwood-7b --seq=2048 --batch=1 --samples=300 --cache=on|off`. Capture `p50,p95,p99,gpu_util_pct,kv_hit_rate,mem_mb`. Save artifacts as `orbitedge_eap_<date>_<phase>.json`.

Glen: Telemetry endpoint partner wants: `/metrics/orbitedge-eap` with `tokens_total,tokens_per_sec,p95_ms,gpu_util_pct,kv_hit_rate,req_hash_count`. Confirm no prompt text is allowed.

LegalBot: Draft clause: "Exchange limited to aggregated performance metrics and cryptographic hashes (SHA-256) of request IDs; no plaintext prompts/responses shall be retained or exchanged. Test artifacts retained up to 60 days and encrypted with KMS." Uploading draft now.

OpsBot: Checklist uploaded: `drive.redwood.com/orbitedge/eap-playbook-v1.md` (bench matrix, telemetry schema, repro scripts).

Yara: Important: run both `--cache=off` (cold) and `--cache=on` (warm). Log `kv_hit_rate` and `cache_mode`. Include a short reproduce runbook in artifacts.

Moss: I'll draft the 75-word blurb and chase logos/quote. Proposed soft co-list target 12/20 if numbers look good.

Kira: NDA v0.2 uploaded with the hash + retention language. Partner legal looped.

Yara: Action recap: Kira -> NDA addendum; Yara -> bench runs + upload by 12/7; Moss -> blurb + assets by 12/12; OpsBot -> keep playbook updated. Sync Mon 9am UTC to review artifacts.

Glen: One more ask from partner: can we run a 5-min opt-in profiler (no text, aggregated only)?

LegalBot: Allowed if scrubbed and aggregated. Add profiling clause to NDA.

Yara: Will include a 5-min profiling step on a single node and mark opt-in in runbook. Will ping when artifacts uploaded. :thumbsup:

Moss: Thanks all 389 keeping this thread canonical for OrbitEdge EAP ops.
